text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Daring Tact dropped by 
carrying an enormous bundle.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Replies to fan letters. 
I finally finished writing them all last 
night.
choice_data_list: You finished writing them... by hand?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because I want to properly convey 
my feelings to every single fan.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I make a point of writing down 
my dreams and goals.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Putting them into my own words, penning 
them down, 
and bringing what's in my heart out into 
the open.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Doing that helps me reaffirm my own 
dreams, 
and lets many others know about them 
too...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's a sort of lucky charm 
I've practiced for a long time.
choice_data_list:
So, what kind of dreams did you write in 
the reply letters?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, it's not that. 
I didn't write my dreams in the replies.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I simply want my fans 
to know the feelings straight from my 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That's why I chose to write each one 
stroke by stroke, 
just as I do with my dreams and goals.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Pouring my gratitude into every word from 
the bottom of my heart.
